notes.title: V1.8 is now available, with added puzzle hints!
notes.content:
V1.8 is now available, with added puzzle hints!
We received a lot of feedback from players who said that the game was a bit difficult and that it was difficult to find the puzzles, so we worked overnight to add the puzzle hint feature, which is located on the top left of the game screen. We hope you have a better experience!
Stay tuned to Aurora, more DLC content is in development, so stay tuned!
